---
pagetitle: "Recipes"
page-layout: custom
---

```{=html}
<div class="browse">

<aside class="sidebar" id="sidebar">
  <div class="sidehead">
    <h2>Filters</h2>
    <button id="clear" class="linkbtn" hidden>Clear all</button>
  </div>

  <section class="facet">
    <h3>Show</h3>
    <div class="segmented" role="group" aria-label="Recipe kind">
      <button type="button" data-kind="all" class="on">All</button>
      <button type="button" data-kind="dish">Dishes</button>
      <button type="button" data-kind="component">Components</button>
    </div>
    <label class="switch">
      <input type="checkbox" id="deep" checked>
      <span>Look inside sub-recipes</span>
      <abbr class="tip" title="A recipe that uses another recipe as an ingredient counts as containing that recipe's ingredients too — so filtering by carrot also finds the sauce made with soffritto.">?</abbr>
    </label>
  </section>

  <section class="facet">
    <h3>Tags</h3>
    <div id="tags" class="chips"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="facet">
    <h3>Ingredients</h3>
    <input id="ingq" type="search" placeholder="Find an ingredient…" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Filter the ingredient list">
    <div id="ings" class="checklist"></div>
  </section>

  <p class="sidefoot" id="built"></p>
</aside>

<main class="main">
  <div class="controls">
    <div class="searchwrap">
      <input id="q" type="search" placeholder="Search recipes, tags, ingredients…" autocomplete="off" aria-label="Search recipes">
      <kbd class="hint">/</kbd>
    </div>
    <select id="sort" aria-label="Sort recipes">
      <option value="az">A–Z</option>
      <option value="time">Quickest first</option>
      <option value="short">Fewest ingredients</option>
    </select>
    <div class="viewtoggle" role="group" aria-label="Layout">
      <button type="button" data-view="grid" class="on" title="Grid view" aria-label="Grid view">▦</button>
      <button type="button" data-view="list" title="List view" aria-label="List view">☰</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="resultbar">
    <span id="count">Loading…</span>
    <span id="active" class="activefilters"></span>
  </div>

  <div id="results" class="cards"></div>
  <p id="empty" class="empty" hidden>Nothing matches that. <button type="button" class="linkbtn" data-clear>Clear the filters</button></p>
</main>

</div>

<script src="assets/browse.js"></script>
```
